reason: Examined direct and transitive supplier statements, conventions and the full relevant source arguments. For sigma in S_(n-1), covariance fixes the box containing n in sigma t. Straighten e_(sigma t) using the integral Garnir algorithm. Initially n is at the removable corner of row r<=r_i and hence at the bottom of its column; column sorting keeps it there. If a Garnir move changes n, then n is the greatest affected label and moves rightward. After column sorting it sits at the bottom of a column of height at most its previous column height, so its row never increases; the first move from a removable corner is strictly upward. Thus every standard term still has n in a removable row <=r_i. The field-uniform basis and largest-entry-removable lemma identify V_m; finite invariance needs no AC. Finite constructions use no arbitrary choice; the cited prerequisites are published or earlier ready local items.
